scope: isolated PostgreSQL lifecycle with stub executor and synthetic health; not performance
passed: unconfirmed checkpoint waits without being consumed
quote frozen before a later checkpoint
restart retains quote without duplicate calls
entry uses simulation balances and gas
network preflight holds no transaction lock blocking schema maintenance
idle ticks do not repeat fills
failed exit preflight retains position and charges no gas
later exit replaces reserve with fresh gas exactly once
successful and failed execution evidence persists
concurrent tick is excluded during unlocked preflight
operator cancellation during preflight cannot become a fill
source revoked during unlocked simulation cannot become a fill
